title: Sturdy and works great
text:
Sturdy and works great. This is well made. It's sturdy and does a great job mixing.

Easy to clean and hold. Comfortable in hand.

product_metadata.title: KUFUNG Danish Dough Whisk, Stainless Steel Dutch Bread Mixer, Blender Admixer for Cake Dessert Bread Pizza Pastry Food - Perfect Baking Tool (Hardwood, L)
features: 【Material】: Made of high quality stainless steel ring and wooden handle, all materials are food grade materials,absolutely safe.
【Upgraded Version】 : Our new second-generation stainless dough whisk has the two eyes design, which can save time and increase efficiency by 50% compared with single-eye design whisk.

【Durability】: The KUFUNG Kitchen Danish Dough Whisk gives traditional magic touch to your dough blending tasks. It provides an easier stirring process compared to that of a wooden spoon that either breaks or gives out in the long run.
【Easy To Clean】: convenient for cleaning. Compared with other products, the paste is not clogged and easy to clean. It is washed with hot water immediately after use. It is brand new as before.

【Loop Design】: Constructed with three loops that provide a flow-through design, it can cut through batter and dough easily. Aerate yeasty, high moisture dough like sourdough and pizza dough with ease. Perfect for making the best cream puff, bread, batters for cakes, cupcakes, pancakes, and muffins.
